exclusions: Only relevance to comments and adjacent explanation/documentation determined selection; no ranking, quality filter or recommendation was applied.

General career advice, ethics, mathematical/performance exposition, deployment/security details and generic management anecdotes were excluded when they did not explain a position on code explanation. Unit notes identify the local boundaries.

Foreword praise, publisher/audiobook credits and publication metadata are not treated as code-comment advice. Book production was included where it explains tested generated code examples or documentation representation.

Lexical false positives include document databases, personal names/addresses, e-reader, documented extinction, mathematical reasons, and substring matches such as latest/protested; these alone are not relevant passages.
unresolved_gaps: All 1342 available normalized transcript lines were read; this is coverage of the local machine transcript, not exhaustive reading or verification of the published book.

Machine recognition may omit, repeat or mishear speech; original audio was not checked. Proper names, language names, mathematical statements and spoken code may be corrupted. No wording was silently corrected.

Audiobook code/diagram adaptation and author dialogue differ from a printed book; exact wording, syntax, speaker identity and edition remain unverified. Cue timestamps are audio windows, not word-level locations.
